name: Aurelion, sword swing
source: atk-aurelion.png (Sacha's reworked sheet, recoloured with recolor-sprite.mjs): 3 frames in a row (sword raised, cut down in front, follow-through low behind), split with split-sheet.mjs --grid 3x1, the cut and the follow-through sampled on a 3.75 px grid, the raised sword on a 4.1 px one (it was drawn a tenth larger), so that he stands as tall as in his standing pose (his helm crest to eye 22 pixels, as there) and put on his palette; the cut and the follow-through cut to columns 1..209 and rows 67..305 of their 286 x 379 grids
